Magical Beast (Evil) · SM +0 Hellwasp Swarm [Monster Manual, page 238]

A vortex of thumb-sized infernal wasps that behaves less like insects and more like one thing with a plan. Fire does not disperse it. It flows through gaps in armour, and it can occupy a body and walk it around long after the occupant has stopped agreeing.

StingNo attack roll and no active defense. Contact agent: the target automatically takes 1 point of toxic damage unless wearing sealed armor. Natural DR does not help unless the creature keeps eyes, mouth, nose and ears shut. Retreating or dodging and dropping a yard away avoids it.no roll1 point toxicC
Inhabit (Possession)Requires one minute of preparation in contact with the victim. The swarm parasitically possesses an SM-2 or larger creature and controls all its actions, or animates a corpse of up to 18 HP. An inhabited corpse grabs, lifts, strikes and throws at ST equal to its HP, uses the swarm's DX, and has Move equal to 18 minus the corpse's HP. Resolve as Possession with the Parasitic enhancement.——C

The fan-conversion source states no appearing-in-numbers or wandering values, so these are derived, not source mechanics.
